# Per-user secrets (refresh)

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P3 · Act as the user](../README.md#phase-3--act-as-the-user) · **Lane:** Worker · **Label:** `feature:refresh-model` · **Epic:** [#138](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/138) · **Tickets:** 5 (1S 3M 1L)

Secret mappings can be marked perUser with a provider, so the worker swaps a placeholder for an access token minted from the calling user's own refresh token. Access tokens are cached per (sub, provider) until expiry, refreshed once on an upstream 401, and rotated refresh tokens are written back to the backend.

## How we build it

- Config: SecretMapping gains perUser bool, provider string, scopes []string (yaml perUser, provider, scopes); placeholder is required, envVar forbidden when perUser is true. Mapping is CP-distributed so the agent scope cap is known to the broker.
- New interface secrets.UserTokenSource { AccessToken(ctx, sub, provider string) (Token, error); Invalidate(sub, provider) } implemented over SecretStore: Get warden/users/<sub>/<provider>, if access token valid (expiry - 60s) use it, else refresh at provider tokenURL, Put back rotated refresh token, cache in memory keyed (sub, provider) with singleflight.
- Swap: in internal/proxy swapSecrets, per-user placeholders resolve with the request's verified sub; missing sub → 403 identity_required; missing grant (Get not-found or invalid_grant) → hand to the JIT stage, never 503.
- 401 retry: after the upstream response, if status 401 and a per-user token was swapped and the body was buffered, Invalidate, mint a new token and replay once; otherwise relay the 401.
- Write support: SecretStore implementation for Vault KV v2 (Get/Put/Delete/List over HTTP API) alongside the existing awsSecretStore; worker credentials scoped to read + write on warden/users/* only for rotation.
- Logs, events and metrics carry only provider and secret Reference, never values.

## Done when

A request from user A through a perUser Google mapping carries A's access token upstream, user B's request carries B's, and an expired or 401'd token is refreshed transparently with the rotated refresh token persisted.

### 1/5 · W-P3-PUS-01

**Add Vault KV v2 SecretStore with write support**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#139](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/139)

Add internal/secrets/vault_store.go implementing SecretStore over Vault KV v2 (GET/POST data/, DELETE metadata/, LIST metadata/) with a mount and namePrefix, keeping VaultFetcher for back-compat. Extend SecretStoreConfig with backend vault (addr, mount, namePrefix, tokenEnv) and wire it in worker.go and controlplane.NewSecretStore. Follow the by-reference logging rules in store.go.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Against an httptest Vault fake, Put then Get round-trips and Delete removes the key
- [ ] List returns metadata only and never calls the data read path
- [ ] secretStore.backend: vault parses and validates; missing addr fails

**Unblocks:** [`W-P3-PUS-03`](refresh-model.md#35--w-p3-pus-03) Implement UserTokenSource with cache, refresh and write-back

### 2/5 · W-P3-PUS-02

**Extend SecretMapping with perUser, provider and scopes**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue —

Add PerUser, Provider and Scopes to config.SecretMapping with validation (provider required when perUser; envVar forbidden), carry per-user mappings on the CP policy wire as perUserSecrets [{placeholder, provider, scopes, agent}] so the broker can cap scopes, and update configs/config.example.yaml. Static mappings stay local and off the wire as today.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] perUser: true without provider fails validation
- [ ] GET /policy includes perUserSecrets without any value fields
- [ ] Existing configs without the new fields load byte-identically

**Unblocks:** [`W-P3-PUS-03`](refresh-model.md#35--w-p3-pus-03) Implement UserTokenSource with cache, refresh and write-back

### 3/5 · W-P3-PUS-03

**Implement UserTokenSource with cache, refresh and write-back**

Type **feature** · Size **L** · Issue —

Add internal/secrets/usertoken.go with UserTokenSource over SecretStore plus a provider token client (refresh_token grant against the provider tokenURL from the CP-distributed provider metadata, client secret resolved by ref). Cache tokens per (sub, provider) with singleflight, early expiry margin 60s, max entries bound (LRU), and an epoch map so a userGrantEpochs bump from policy invalidates entries. Rotated refresh tokens are Put back; ErrGrantMissing is returned for not-found or invalid_grant.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Concurrent requests for the same (sub, provider) cause one refresh call
- [ ] A provider response with a new refresh_token is written back to the store
- [ ] invalid_grant returns ErrGrantMissing and evicts the cache entry
- [ ] Bumping the user's epoch forces a re-read on the next call

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-PUS-01`](refresh-model.md#15--w-p3-pus-01) Add Vault KV v2 SecretStore with write support; [`W-P3-PUS-02`](refresh-model.md#25--w-p3-pus-02) Extend SecretMapping with perUser, provider and scopes

**Unblocks:** [`W-P3-PORT-02`](consent-portal.md#24--w-p3-port-02) Implement revoke: provider revoke, vault delete, worker invalidation; [`W-P3-PUS-04`](refresh-model.md#45--w-p3-pus-04) Swap per-user placeholders in the proxy using verified sub

### 4/5 · W-P3-PUS-04

**Swap per-user placeholders in the proxy using verified sub**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

In internal/proxy/http.go swapSecrets, resolve per-user placeholders via Proxy.userTokens().AccessToken(ctx, s.identity.Sub, provider) and inject as the placeholder value; static placeholders keep the existing Cache path. No verified sub → 403 with reason identity_required; ErrGrantMissing → set s.authRequired and return to the JIT stage. Record the provider and a Reference in swappedNames/analytics; wire the source in internal/worker/wiring.go with hot reload through the applier.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Two users through the same mapping get their own tokens upstream (fake upstream asserts)
- [ ] A missing grant never forwards the request and never returns 503
- [ ] Analytics events contain the placeholder name and provider, not the token

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-PUS-03`](refresh-model.md#35--w-p3-pus-03) Implement UserTokenSource with cache, refresh and write-back

### 5/5 · W-P3-PUS-05

**Retry once on upstream 401 with a freshly minted token**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

In readUpstreamResponse/relayResponse, when the response is 401, a per-user token was swapped and the request body is buffered (within maxBodySwapSize), drain the response, Invalidate (sub, provider), mint a new token and replay the request once on a fresh upstream connection. Streaming or over-cap bodies are not retried and the 401 is relayed. Count retries in a bounded metric warden_user_token_retry_total{provider,outcome}.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Fake upstream returning 401 then 200 yields a 200 to the agent with exactly two upstream calls
- [ ] Two consecutive 401s relay the second 401 without a third attempt
- [ ] A chunked request body is not replayed

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-PUS-04`](refresh-model.md#45--w-p3-pus-04) Swap per-user placeholders in the proxy using verified sub
